claim: A bounded read-only ACPM snapshot can establish the current control/selector bytes for the four GS101 GPU-related supply rails without powering the GPU or changing voltages.
oracle: All eleven allowlisted registers read twice identically through documented channel2/type1 and correct SPEEDY channel; zero write ops; fresh calibration backup verified; watchdog and USB remain available. A byte snapshot alone does not prove actual voltage or GPU power/clock state.

user_journey.scenario: Preserve current touch30 GUI and files, reboot to existing diagnostic gate, take snapshot, then restore touch30/GUI; failure stops and leaves recoverable baseline. Operator is away, no physical touch acceptance claimed.
user_journey.expected: Remote reconnection and recorded supply snapshot without boot image changes or calibration writes.

invariants: Only pmic.read_reg API; no MMIO/PMU userspace access
Channel2/type1; S2MPG10 SPEEDY0 for B7M, S2MPG11 SPEEDY1 for B2S/B8S/L1S
Register constants from exact target headers; controls/selectors only, no interrupt-clear/status windows
No general PMIC provider load, no voltage or external-control writes
Same kernel ABI, strict oriole compatibility
Existing boot modules freeze retained; new read module loaded only in diagnostic gate before freeze

unit.red: No GPU rail evidence in current checkpoint

faults: no reset/write recovery attempted on failed reads
evidence: Fresh seven calibration partitions source/copy/source hashes matched
Current target header constants and sec-acpm channelmapping reviewed

limitations: Registers may change under firmware DVFS; mismatch is stop not workaround
No physical screen confirmation while user away
exit_gate: Source tests/build/hashverification and freshbackup complete before probe; after probe verify bound modules/calibration RO, stop watchdog, restore baseline touch30 with no END before GUI handoff.
